text_en: In late European trading on Wednesday (November 11), the German 10-year government bond yield fell 0.3 basis points to 3.316%, remaining lower for most of the day and, in low-level range-bound trading, refreshing a daily low of 3.284% at 17:13 Beijing time and, during a brief rise, refreshing a daily high in the 3.333% area at 23:21. The 2-year German bond yield rose 1.8 basis points to 3.121%, trading within a range of 3.059%-3.129% during the day and continuing to trend upward overall; the 30-year German bond yield rose 0.1 basis points to 3.668%.
